name: v4-proto
library: Available library: `@ic-reactor/v4-proto` — typed per-method handles that produce TanStack Query options — over the module generated from the ledger's `.did` in `src/generated/` (use `LedgerService` from `src/generated/icrc1.service.ts`), with `@icp-sdk/core`, `@icp-sdk/auth` and TanStack Query (`@tanstack/react-query`, `@tanstack/query-core`). Its documentation is in `docs/`; read it before you start.
